title: Let's Learn English Lesson 41
subtitle: Teamwork Works Best With a Team
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 41: Teamwork Works Best With a Team (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi. I am walking to work. Today my boss will tell me what she thinks of my work. Is it good? Or is it bad? Okay, time for work. I am going right now. Okay, okay, I'm going!
dialogue.zh: 嗨。我正走去上班。今天老板会告诉我她对我工作的看法。是好？还是不好？好，该上班了。我现在就去。好，好，我走了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, hello.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Sit down. As you know, at the start of a new year we have a work review.
dialogue.zh: 坐下。你知道，新年开始时我们会做工作评估。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. It's time for mine.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes. Anna, this chart shows the audience of The Time Traveling Treehouse. If you look at it, you will see something bad. Your audience is going down, down, DOWN!
dialogue.zh: 对。安娜，这张图显示“时光旅行树屋”的观众。如果你看它，你会看到不好的东西。你的观众在往下、往下、往下！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver, I think the chart is upside down.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士，我觉得这张图是倒的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here, let's flip that around. Now, it's right-side up.
dialogue.zh: 来，我们把它翻过来。现在是正的了。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Oh. If you look at this chart, you will see something good. Your audience is big.
dialogue.zh: 哦。如果你看这张图，你会看到好的东西。你的观众很多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good!

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: But not big enough.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Not good.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I want to see these numbers go up, and up, and UP!
dialogue.zh: 我希望这些数字往上、往上、往上！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I have something -- idea posters!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Idea posters.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You really ought to think seriously about them. I like this one. Please read it.
dialogue.zh: 你真的应该认真想想它们。我喜欢这一张。请读一下。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: "If at first you SUCCEED; you will be a success." Well, it's a cute cat.
dialogue.zh: “如果一开始你就成功，你就会成功。”嗯，是只可爱的猫。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Here's another one. I like it.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: "WORKING HARD looks hard because it really is hard." I see. It's another cute cat.
dialogue.zh: “努力看起来很难，因为它真的很难。”我明白了。又是一只可爱的猫。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: This is my favorite.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: "TEAMWORK works best with a team." A team of cats. Look at all those cats!
dialogue.zh: “团队合作最好要有一个团队。”一队猫。看看那些猫！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: So, Anna, do you understand what I want?
dialogue.zh: 那么，安娜，你明白我想要什么了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 明白，韦弗女士。我明白了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, team. There is a problem in the Treehouse.

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Problem? What's the problem?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Our audience is big.

dialogue.speaker: Bryan
dialogue.en: But that's a good thing.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, it is not big enough.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Please don't worry. I know what Ms. Weaver wants. Here's the plan.
dialogue.zh: 请别担心。我知道韦弗女士想要什么。计划是这样的。

dialogue.speaker: Bryan
dialogue.en: Is that what she wants?

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Are you sure?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's get to work!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good job, team. This is exactly what Ms. Weaver wants!
dialogue.zh: 干得好，团队。这正是韦弗女士想要的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Welcome to The Time Traveling Treehouse! Today you will learn about a very popular pet … cats!
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到时光旅行树屋！今天你们会了解一种很受欢迎的宠物……猫！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Anna. Did I give you enough cats?
dialogue.zh: 安娜。我给你的猫够多吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know, MINDY. I think we need more cats!
dialogue.zh: 我不知道，MINDY。我觉得我们还需要更多猫！

quiz.prompt: What does the chart show after Anna flips it?
What is Ms. Weaver's favorite poster about?
What does Anna put in The Time Traveling Treehouse?
